    StartersFlying V fried cheese bitesBattered mozzarella cubes fried golden with ranch for dippingHow to make it400g firm mozzarella1 cup self-raising flour250ml cold milksalt, to taste1 L vegetable oil200ml ranch dressingCut the mozzarella into 2cm cubes. Whisk the flour, milk and salt into a batter.Dip the cubes in the batter and chill briefly so they hold their shape.Fry in 5cm of hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes until golden.Drain and serve with ranch dressing.Juicy Lucy slidersCheese-stuffed beef sliders with American cheese melted in the middleHow to make it700g beef mince4 slices of American cheese, halved8 slider buns4 dill pickles, slicedDivide the mince into 16 thin patties. Sandwich half a slice of cheese between 2 patties and pinch the edges sealed to make 8.Griddle 4 minutes a side, then rest 2 minutes so the cheese doesn't burst.Serve in the slider buns with pickles.Creamy chicken wild rice soup cupsA cold Minneapolis winterHow to make itAs written, serves 4Wild rice simmered with chicken, carrot, celery and onion in a creamy thyme stock, ladled into small cups with buttered bread fingers.Soften a diced onion, a carrot and 2 celery sticks in 30g butter.Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 1.2L chicken stock, 120g wild rice blend and thyme.Add 400g chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until the rice is tender.Shred the chicken back in and stir through 150ml cream.Ladle into cups and serve with fingers of buttered toast.MainsMinnesota hotdishBeef, mushroom, corn and green bean casserole under crisp potato gemsHow to make it600g beef mince1 brown onion, diced200g mushrooms, sliced200g corn kernels200g green beans, chopped250ml thickened cream500g frozen potato gemsBrown the mince with the onion and mushrooms.Stir in the corn, beans and cream. Tip into a baking dish and cover with potato gems.Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes until golden.Team dinner fish fryCrisp battered fish, chips and tartare. Ducks stick togetherHow to make it600g flathead fillets150g plain flour250ml cold soda water1 L vegetable oil, for frying1kg potatoes, cut in thick chips2 tbsp olive oil150g mayonnaise1 tbsp capers, chopped2 gherkins, chopped2 lemonsMix the mayonnaise with the capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon for the tartare.Toss the chips in the olive oil and salt and bake at 220°C, turning once, until crisp.Whisk 120g of the flour with the soda water to a thin batter. Dust the fish in the rest of the flour.Dip the fish in the batter and fry in hot oil at 180°C, a few at a time, until golden.Drain, salt and serve with the chips, tartare and lemon wedges.SweetsHans' frozen pond browniesFudgy brownies covered with a smooth layer of white chocolateHow to make it200g dark chocolate150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs100g plain flour150g white chocolateMelt the dark chocolate and butter. Whisk in the sugar and eggs and fold in the flour.Bake in a lined tin at 170°C for 25 minutes. Cool.Melt the white chocolate, spread it smooth over the top like ice, set, then cut into squares.DrinksDistrict 5 rinkside hot chocolateThick dark hot chocolate topped with marshmallowsHow to make it1 L milk150g dark chocolate, chopped100g marshmallowsHeat the milk until steaming.Whisk in the chocolate until frothy.Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top.
